title: commander: locate why a transposed typo suggests two options
prompt: In this copy of commander.js a regression was introduced: with options `--port <n>` and `--post <b>` defined, running with the typo `--prot` prints `(Did you mean one of --port, --post?)` instead of `(Did you mean --port?)`; an unknown command `strat` next to commands `start` and `strip` has the same problem. Typos with a swapped pair of adjacent letters used to be treated as a single edit. Find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change; other suggestion behaviour must stay the same.
